craft_notes: Sthāyin: time-mechanism (days as eraser). Rows: row 1 (as-thus frame). Rupture: colon — instruction, then duration. Close: days (dinaiḥ — the patient word; minimal pass keeps it final). Rejected: 'weeks' — killed: days kept; 'dissolves strangeness' — killed: drops away (gradual, matches kṣaya).

lines: As thus where there, twelve-end the mind should cast:
moment by moment — strangeness of turning drops in days.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā tathā yatra tatra dvādaśānte manaḥ kṣipet || pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣīṇavṛtter vailakṣaṇyaṃ dinair bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Where must the mind be cast? → Cast at the twelve-end moment by moment, strangeness wears away in days.
c1_essence: Mind cast at twelve-end: strangeness drops away in days.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
